item.title: 51 municipalities face criticism for lack of data protection in schools
item.description: Danish municipalities have inadequately protected public school students’ personal data when using Google products, according to Datatilsynet. This decision forms part of the Chromebook case, which concerns these municipalities’ use of Google Workspace for Education and […]

item.title: Residents can access annual tax report starting March 23rd
item.description: The Danish Tax Agency has announced that the annual tax statement will be available on March 23, 2026, viewable on TastSelv at skat.dk. Deputy Director Ulrick Junge notes that preparations are underway to ensure the smooth release of tax calculations and guidance. item.title: Unusual January was the coldest in 16 years
item.description: January 2026 in Denmark was unusually cold, being the coldest in 16 years with an average temperature of minus 0.6 degrees Celsius, significantly below the normal of 1.6 degrees. item.title: Danish Originals, S9E9: Holly Dorger
item.description: In this episode of Danish Originals, American-Danish ballet dancer Holly Dørger reflects on her journey from the United States to Denmark, her career with The Royal Danish Ballet, and life as a creative in Copenhagen.
